items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: So your very first job was with Joseph Salvaggio... It was a Lombardo type band... We all had things to do in a day... I was ready to make a move... That's why I moved to the Blue Parody

ctx.x: Testing one, two, three, four, five. How's this old Cajun coming out now?
Except it came out in English. So your very first job was with Joseph Salvaggio, and you say it was something like Lombardo style.
It was a Lombardo type band, Dick.
